errRecovery.message: Recovery could not be completed. Try again.

extDescription.message: Sends links and, optionally, Firefox downloads to Lyra Downloads.

statusEngineStopped.message: The download engine is not running.

errInvalidLink.message: The link is not a valid address.

errOnlyHttp.message: Only http:// and https:// links can be sent to Lyra Downloads.

errTimeout.message: Lyra Downloads did not respond in time.

manualHelp.message: Right-click a link and choose “Download with Lyra Downloads”. The application opens the new download dialog; if you cancel, nothing is created.

autoEnable.message: Use Lyra Downloads for Firefox downloads

autoHelp.message: Off by default. When enabled, downloads started in Firefox are handed to Lyra Downloads, and Firefox only cancels its copy after Lyra confirms. Private windows, downloads using POST or authentication, blob:/data: downloads, downloads Firefox cannot pause and, by default, those sending cookies always stay in Firefox. When enabled, Firefox requests permission to monitor requests from the selected sites. You can turn this off here or using the extension button at any time.

cookiesHelp.message: Lyra Downloads does not receive your cookies. Downloads from sites where you are signed in may fail in Lyra (the Firefox copy will already have been canceled). Leave this unchecked if unsure.

extensionsHelp.message: Comma-separated extensions. The file name is the one Firefox selected (including Content-Disposition), not just the end of the address.

errInvalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain, for example: sourceforge.net

errInvalidExtensions.message: Enter valid extensions, for example: iso, img, zip

errNeedDomain.message: Add at least one site in settings or choose “All sites”.

errPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied; Lyra Downloads will not be used for Firefox downloads.

cookiesAll.message: Capture even when the browser sends cookies

showApp.message: Show the Lyra Downloads window when receiving a download

popupDefaultOn.message: On: new Firefox downloads will go to Lyra Downloads.

errHandoff.message: Could not complete the handoff. Check the Firefox downloads panel and try again.

handoffUncertain.message: Could not confirm which application is downloading. The Firefox copy remains paused. Use “Recover in Firefox” to check and continue safely.

handoffCleanup.message: Lyra Downloads took over the download, but Firefox could not cancel its paused copy. Remove it from the Firefox downloads panel.

handoffInFirefox.message: The download is already in Firefox.

handoffResumeFailed.message: Firefox could not resume the paused download. Use “Restart in Firefox” to start again.

handoffCanceled.message: The handoff to Lyra Downloads was canceled.

handoffPauseFailed.message: Firefox could not pause this download (or it already finished); it stays in Firefox to avoid duplicate transfers.

handoffRestartRequested.message: Restart requested in Firefox; check the downloads panel.

handoffRestartFailed.message: Firefox could not restart the download. Try again.

handoffRestarted.message: Download restarted in Firefox (from the beginning).

errInvalidResponse.message: Invalid response from the integration component.

errHostMissing.message: Lyra Downloads or its Firefox integration component is not installed or registered.

errNativeUrl.message: Only valid HTTP or HTTPS addresses without embedded credentials are supported.

errNativeDestination.message: Check the destination folder in Lyra Downloads.

errNativeApp.message: Could not open Lyra Downloads. Check that the application and its integration are installed.

errNativeVersion.message: The installed integration is incompatible. Update Lyra Downloads and this extension.

errNativeBackend.message: Lyra Downloads could not complete the operation. Open the application for details.
